# WatchTower

> WatchTower is an interactive country intelligence atlas covering demographics, economics, government, health, crime, migration, and security.

Canonical site: https://watchtower.app/

## Site structure

- Home and atlas: https://watchtower.app/
- Country dossiers use lowercase country slugs, for example: https://watchtower.app/germany
- Dossiers may include demographics, economics, government, health, crime, migration, military, and current-events sections.
- Figures should be read together with the source and methodology notes shown beside them.

## Access policy

Automated AI crawlers are disallowed by https://watchtower.app/robots.txt. This file is provided as a concise site guide for people and manually initiated tools; it does not override that policy.
